name: I Can Do All Things
overview: Scripture reveals that through faith in God and abiding in Christ, believers can overcome challenges that seem impossible by human strength alone. The Lord assures His presence and support, promising to strengthen and uphold His people (Isaiah 41:10). Jesus teaches that with God, all things are possible, emphasizing that belief unlocks divine power (Matthew 19:26; Mark 9:23; Mark 10:27; Luke 1:37). However, this ability is rooted in a vital connection to Christ, who is the true source of life and fruitfulness, for apart from Him we can do nothing (John 15:5).
